It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2007.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 4, 2021}} It was created after the 2006 reapportionment that divided the province into two congressional districts.{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2006/10/02/republic-act-no-9357/ |title=Republic Act No. 9357 |date=2 October 2006 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=March 4, 2021}} The district is composed of the coastal and western municipalities of [[Bagumbayan, Sultan Kudarat|Bagumbayan]], [[Esperanza, Sultan Kudarat|Esperanza]], [[Kalamansig]], [[Lebak, Sultan Kudarat|Lebak]], [[Palimbang]] and [[Senator Ninoy Aquino, Sultan Kudarat|Senator Ninoy Aquino]]. It is currently represented in the [[18th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by Bella Vanessa B.
